paragraphs.text: Ich-Tekik , whose name roughly translates to "reap and give," is a phyrexian artificer from New Phyrexia .

Ich-Tekik prides himself on being Vorinclex 's splicer. Vorinclex has taken a great interest in Ich-Tekik's mindless golems , believing that they have the potential to become the ultimate predator or at least make good test subjects for his experiments.

Ich-Tekik has been given free rein to harvest any materials from Vorinclex's domain, including ones that may still be attached to living beings. He harvests parts liberally, grafting them onto both his golems and himself. He created Vexyr as his living legacy.
